auth.modeTabs: Sign in or create an account
auth.signInLead: Use the Google or GitHub account you registered with SpecGate.
auth.signUpLead: Sign up with a Google or GitHub account you already have. SpecGate has no password of its own.
auth.errorOauth: Sign-in failed. Try again or pick another account.
auth.errorCancelled: You cancelled sign-in at the provider. No account was created.
auth.errorBackend: Cannot reach the SpecGate server. Please try again in a few minutes.
auth.signUpStep1: Pick Google or GitHub and allow SpecGate to read your name and email.
auth.signUpStep2: SpecGate creates your account and a personal workspace.
auth.signUpStep3: Enter your agent's API key to start chatting.
auth.guidePersonalBody: Enter an API key and chat with your own agent; only you see it. Keep the passages worth keeping and send them to the team once you are sure.
auth.guideCodeBody: A member of the shared workspace clicks Share code and sends you the 7-character code.
auth.guideApprovalTitle: Enter the code, wait for approval
auth.guideApprovalBody: The workspace owner confirms you; the workspace then appears in the left bar.
auth.guideExploreBody: Search the Explore page and send a request with a note to the owner.
auth.chooseAccount: Choose an account to continue to SpecGate
auth.otherAccount: Use another {provider} account that is not registered yet
auth.simulatedNote: Simulated screen: once the backend configures {provider} OAuth, this step is {provider}'s real page.
auth.displayNamePlaceholder: The name people see in channels
auth.agreeAndCreate: Agree and create an account with {provider}
auth.createFailed: Could not create the account. Please try again.
auth.heroFoot: No password of its own: sign in with the Google or GitHub account you already have.

workspace.personalTitle: Personal workspace: chat with your agent on your own key
workspace.noShared: Not in any shared workspace yet
workspace.exploreTitle: Find shared workspaces and ask to join
workspace.noAgents: Nobody has entered a key yet.
workspace.createDialogDescription: Where the whole team works on one brief, each person bringing their own agent.
workspace.name: Name
workspace.briefRequired: · required; every member's agent reads it
workspace.visibilityDiscoverable: Anyone can find it, joining needs approval
workspace.visibilityHint: Others join with a code you share, or ask from the Explore page; you approve each person.
workspace.noWorkspaceAgent: A shared workspace has no agent of its own. Each member uses the agent of their personal workspace, on their own key, and sends filtered passages to the channel.
workspace.createFailed: Could not create the workspace. Please try again.
workspace.channelDialogDescription: Lowercase letters without accents, digits and hyphens, for example peer-review.
workspace.nicknameDescription: Someone in this workspace already has your name. Pick a nickname, such as "Lan B" or "Lan Pham". It is used everywhere in the workspace: channels, your agent's name and the context sent to agents.

join.codeDialogTitle: Join a shared workspace with a code
join.codeDialogDescription: Enter the 7-character code a member shared. Your request waits for the owner's approval.
join.codeHelp: Ask a member for the code. Once the owner approves, you are in.
join.requestFailed: Could not send the request. Please try again.
join.statusPendingBody: Your request to join {workspace} was sent. Once {owner} approves, this page opens the workspace for you.
join.statusRejectedBody: {owner} did not let you into {workspace}. You can ask for a new code and try again.
join.statusCancelledBody: Your request to join {workspace} was cancelled.
join.pollingNote: Waiting for confirmation, checking every 3 seconds
join.shareDescription: Send this code to whoever wants to join. They click the key button in the left bar, enter the code and wait for the owner's approval.
join.ownerRegenerateHint: Change the code if it leaks: the old one stops working at once.
join.memberRegenerateHint: Only the owner can change the code.
join.noCodeOwner: This workspace has no join code yet.
join.noCodeMember: This workspace has no join code yet. Ask the owner to create one.
join.exploreMeta: {count} shared workspaces open to join requests
join.notMemberAlert: You are not a member of "{name}" yet. Enter a join code if you have one, or send a request on the right.
join.exploreHeading: Find a team to think with
join.exploreLead: Have a code? Enter it. No code? Search and send a request. Either way the owner approves you.
join.noOpenWorkspaces: No shared workspace is open to outsiders yet.
join.pendingLink: You already asked and are waiting for approval. See status
join.messagePlaceholder: Who you are and what you want to bring to this brief
join.requestHint: You get in once the owner approves. Then bring passages worth discussing from your personal workspace as highlights.

requests.noProcessed: No request has been processed yet.

settings.briefOwnerHint: Editing the brief changes every agent's context from its next call.
settings.briefMemberHint: Only the owner can edit the brief.
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave this workspace? You will need to ask to join again. Your name keeps its place in old messages.
settings.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the workspace? Their name keeps its place in old messages.
settings.briefDescription: Every member's agent reads this brief with each question.
settings.joinCodeDescription: Send the code to people who want to join. The owner still approves each person.
settings.teamDescription: Each person's name in the workspace, team role and personal agent. Nobody sees anyone else's key.
settings.renameDescription: This name shows everywhere in the workspace and must differ from everyone else's.
settings.workspaceDescription: Only the owner changes the name and who can find the workspace.
settings.workspaceFailed: Could not save the name and visibility.

board.noNotes: No notes yet. Type /note in a channel or click Add idea.
board.channelSummaryHint: The owner types /summarize in a channel; the owner's agent posts a summary right below it.
board.addDescription: Ideas go to the Proposed column; notes are constraints or facts the team must remember.
board.decideDescription: Only members decide. Agents never decide on their own.
board.reasonPlaceholder: Why decide or reject this idea?

brief.builtMeta: Built {time} by {name}, from {count} members and their personal agents
brief.emptyOwner: Click Build at the top, or type /brief in a channel. The summary is built from the idea board: decided, rejected and open ideas, and notes.
brief.emptyMember: The owner builds the summary from the idea board; every member can read and download it.

highlight.noticePartial: A passage is cut mid-sentence: the agent receives it marked "partial quote".
highlight.noticeRelayed: Taken from a summary: the agent is told this is a retelling, not anyone's own position.
highlight.addNoteOrLabel: Add a note or change the label

channel.ownSelectionNotice: Your own messages are already in your agent's context
channel.highlightSaved: Highlight saved. Your agent reads it on your next question.
channel.highlightSkipped: {count} passages were your own messages and were left out (already in context).
channel.intro: No agent replies here on its own. An agent's words enter the channel only when its owner sends a private highlight, credited to its speaker. Select someone else's passage so your agent can read it; your own messages it reads by itself.
channel.partialCut: Cut mid-sentence: this is only part of the original words.
channel.channelSummaryTag: · channel summary, not filtered by anyone
channel.offline: Connection lost: not sent yet, your draft is kept.
channel.composerHint: Press Enter to send. Type @ and pick "My highlights" to bring a filtered passage from your personal workspace.
channel.noPrivateHighlights: No private highlights yet. Select a passage worth keeping in a conversation with your agent to save it.
channel.sendFailed: Could not send the message, try again later.
channel.dialogDescription: Your agent reads these passages with their speakers in every conversation that uses this workspace as team context. A highlight is not a team decision, and only you see it.
channel.narrowOnly: You may only trim the ends, not edit or delete words inside {speaker}'s passage. To drop a middle clause, select it again as two separate passages.
channel.agentReadsPartial: , noting that it is cut mid-sentence
channel.agentReadsRelayed: , told that it is a retelling, not anyone's own position
channel.ownSkipped: · your own message, already in context, so left out.
channel.label: Label

commands.ideaDescription: Put an idea on the board
commands.pinDescription: Put the message you reply to on the board
commands.decideDescription: Decide or reject an idea, with a reason
commands.summarizeDescription: Summarize the channel with the owner's agent (owner only)
commands.taskDescription: Create a task in your name; the owner adds @name to assign it

home.greeting: Hi {name}, which ideas shall we sift today?
home.lead: Chat privately with your agent, keep the passages worth keeping, then bring them to the team once you are sure.
home.enterKey: Enter an API key to get an agent
home.noTeamHint: Have a join code? Click "Enter code" in the left bar. Want your own team? Click "Create".

personal.keySaveFailed: Could not save the key, try again later.
personal.conversationCreateFailed: Could not create the conversation, try again later.
personal.sendFailed: Could not send to the channel.
personal.streamInterrupted: The connection dropped midway. What arrived is kept in the conversation; click Regenerate for a full answer.
personal.askFailed: Could not send the question, try again later.
personal.savedPrivate: Saved to Private highlights. Nothing has been sent to the team.
personal.offline: Connection lost: not sent yet, your draft is kept.
personal.linkedHint: The agent reads the context of {name}. Select a passage to save a private highlight.
personal.defaultHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. Select a passage to save a private highlight.
personal.regenerateDescription: This answer has private highlights. If you keep them they stay in the list but no longer point to a place in the conversation.
personal.notePlaceholder: Short note, for example: ask the team again
personal.stoppedNote: Stopped. This is what the agent had written by then.
personal.emptyTitle: Ask anything, only you can see it
personal.emptyBodyAfter: with your own key. Pick a shared workspace as team context and the agent knows what the team is discussing. Select passages worth keeping to save private highlights; once you are sure, send them to the team's channel.
personal.teamRoleHint: Every member's agent can read this role.
personal.boardSummary: {decided} decided and {rejected} rejected ideas, with reasons. The agent is told not to propose rejected ideas again.
personal.omittedMessages: {count} of your old messages are not being sent to the agent.
personal.digestDone: {count} older messages were summarized by your agent at {time} into {blocks} blocks placed on the timeline. The summary stays in your personal workspace.
personal.timelineHint: Your messages come here by themselves, including cards you sent. Other people's messages come only when you highlight them.
personal.timelineEmptyAfter: or select someone else's passage for the agent to read.
personal.removeFromContext: Remove the highlight from the context
personal.timelineTruncated: Showing the latest {shown} items; the agent receives all {total}.
personal.privacyFooter: The agent does not read other people's messages unless you highlight them. No one in the team can read this conversation.
personal.summarizeTitle: The agent writes a fixed-format summary and saves it to Private highlights for you to review before sending
personal.deleteConversationTitle: Delete the conversation (messages sent to channels remain)
personal.summaryReadyBody: The summary has not been sent. Review it, edit it or attach a few original turns in Private highlights, then send it once you are sure.
personal.confirmDeleteBody: This conversation has {count} private highlights. Keep or delete them? Kept ones stay in the list, marked "original conversation deleted". Whatever was sent to channels remains.
personal.digestPlanSummarized: {count} blocks summarized by the agent in one call
personal.digestPlanVerbatim: {count} messages in short blocks sent verbatim
personal.digestPlan: Clicking makes your agent, on your key, summarize these {messages} messages into {blocks} time blocks, split at your highlights: {parts}.
personal.saveDigestToShare: Save to Private highlights to share
personal.anthropicHint: The key starts with sk-ant-, created at console.anthropic.com.
personal.openAiHint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama… For any service using the OpenAI format, enter its API address.
personal.keyEncrypted: {note} The key is encrypted when saved; afterwards only its last 4 characters are shown.
personal.enterKeyToStart: Enter a key to start chatting
personal.welcomeCreated: Account created with {provider}, welcome {name}. Your personal workspace is ready; the last step is entering an API key.
personal.privateMeta: {total}/{limit} highlights · only you can see them
personal.agentHighlightsIntro: Passages you selected in other people's messages in shared channels, for your agent to read. Each keeps its exact words and speaker; you can only change your own label and note. A highlight is not a team decision, and only you see it. Each workspace keeps at most {limit} highlights; when full, you remove some yourself, nothing is deleted automatically.
personal.agentHighlightsEmpty: Nothing yet. In a shared workspace channel, select someone else's passage and click "Highlight for my agent".
personal.agentSectionDescription: The model you chat with in your personal workspace; it is also the agent named after you in team channels.
personal.keySectionDescription: Your own key; costs go to your account at the provider.
personal.deleteKeyBody: You cannot chat with your agent until you enter a new key. Conversation history is kept.
personal.tasksHint: Tasks in progress and tasks nobody holds. Finished tasks are not sent to the agent.
personal.confirmDeleteWarning: Deleting the conversation also deletes its earlier highlights. Do you agree?
personal.confirmDeleteEmpty: Whatever was sent to channels remains.

privateHighlights.intro: Select passages worth keeping in conversations with your agent to save them here. Review them when needed, and send them to the team channel only once you are sure. Colours are only for your own sorting and are not sent. Private highlights are not sent to the agent, so they cost nothing on your key.
privateHighlights.nearLimit: You have used {total}/{limit} private highlights. Clean up to make room.
privateHighlights.noTargets: You are not a member of any shared workspace yet, so there is no channel to send to.
privateHighlights.empty: No private highlights yet. In a conversation with your agent, select a passage and pick a colour to save it.
privateHighlights.editedAgentWords: You edited the agent's words: the sent card will say "(edited by you)". Trimming alone does not.
privateHighlights.attachDescription: Pick up to {max} turns. In the channel they sit collapsed inside the summary card for anyone to open.
privateHighlights.snapshotNote: The card in the channel is a snapshot: editing or deleting the highlight later does not change it.
privateHighlights.sendDescription: Review once more. The message appears under {name}, each passage a card credited to its speaker.
privateHighlights.ownWordsPlaceholder: For example: Could you all look at this passage
privateHighlights.summaryOf: Conversation summary by {name}, written by {speaker}, unfiltered
privateHighlights.alreadySentOne: This highlight was already sent to #{channel}.
privateHighlights.cleanupDescription: Delete many items at once by the conditions you pick. Cards sent to channels stay there.
privateHighlights.sentOnly: Only items sent to the team

tasks.bodyPlaceholder: For example: find papers on evaluation methods
tasks.deleteConfirm: This task and all its subtasks will be removed from the task board.
tasks.lockedNotice: The board is locked. Whoever is in charge can still mark their task done.
tasks.actionFailed: Could not update the task board.
tasks.rootPlaceholder: Add a big task, for example: find a project idea
tasks.editDescription: Edit the description or change who is in charge, yourself included.
